data.hook: During a livestream with N3on, Chicago Bulls guard Norman Powell didn't hesitate: 'Bro, I’m gonna say the Lakers' as the NBA's most overrated squad.
data.name: Bulls' Norman Powell Calls Lakers NBA's Most Overrated Team
data.summary: Powell, in his first season with the Bulls after 11 years across five teams, sparked backlash from Lakers fans who labeled it clout chasing and recalled past humiliations like Austin Reaves making him 'touch the floor' or Luka Dončić's 60-point explosion against him. The Lakers head into 2026-27 with hype around new additions like Walker Kessler, Quentin Grimes, Collin Sexton, and Sandro Mamukelashvili joining Dončić and Reaves, though critics say their media buzz outpaces play-in projections. Defenders argue constant league-wide criticism proves they're underrated, fueling the endless debate on Lakers hype versus reality.

Player polls split along lines—active stars pick LeBron as GOAT, retirees favor Jordan—and his games helped drive the NBA's best viewership in years last season.

Fans pushed back hard online, pointing to bigger flops like JaMarcus Russell and Ryan Leaf, and noting J.J. McCarthy went just two picks later. The backlash highlighted the heated debate over Atlanta's quarterback plans and how local radio takes can spark widespread fan reactions.

data.hook: Patrick Mahomes returns from ACL surgery, but an undrafted rookie steps in to protect his blind side against Denver's fierce pass rush.
data.name: Chiefs Rule Out Simmons and Conner for Season Opener vs. Broncos
data.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs will miss left tackle Josh Simmons (back injury) and safety Chamarri Conner (knee) when they host the Denver Broncos on Monday Night Football to open the 2026 season. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson is set for his NFL debut at left tackle, a first under coach Andy Reid, while defensive tackle Chris Jones is expected to play despite a calf issue. After a 6-11 finish last year, all eyes are on how the reshuffled line holds up protecting Mahomes from stars like Nik Bonitto.
